message.content: {"sections":[{"key":"why_this_person","empty":false,"items":[{"h2":"He is building Zafran's ABM motion from scratch","body":[{"text":"Zafran is hiring a Senior Manager, ABM & Integrated Campaigns to own ABM from the ground up, including 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many programs.","claimIds":["zaf-090"]},{"text":"As VP of Marketing and an economic buyer, Nick is a relevant stakeholder for building and scaling that motion.","claimIds":["zaf-038","zaf-039"]}],"sendLine":"In your email: I saw Zafran is building its ABM motion from the ground up, across 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many programs.","contactRefs":[{"name":"Nick Fisher"}],"priority":1},{"h2":"He thinks in terms of real exposure, not raw vulnerability volume","body":[{"text":"In his article \"Why I joined Zafran Security,\" Nick wrote that \"we revealed how 96% of vulnerabilities didn’t require patching and can be mitigated using existing controls.\"","claimIds":["zaf-158","zaf-159"]},{"text":"That framing connects his marketing work to a concrete security problem: helping buyers understand real risk exposure.","claimIds":["zaf-159"]}],"sendLine":"In your email: Your point that 96% of vulnerabilities didn't require patching stood out—especially the focus on understanding real risk exposure.","contactRefs":[{"name":"Nick Fisher"}],"priority":1},{"h2":"A full-stack B2B marketing leader with security-market depth","body":[{"text":"Nick describes himself as a \"Full-stack B2B marketing leader / storyteller with experience building teams for early stage growth and post-IPO scale.\"","claimIds":["zaf-044"]},{"text":"His career history includes VP of Product Marketing at Sysdig, Senior Director of Product Marketing at Okta, and VP of Marketing at Zafran Security.","claimIds":["zaf-045"]}],"sendLine":"In the platform: Position Nick as a senior B2B marketing buyer who combines storytelling, team building, and cybersecurity market experience.","contactRefs":[{"name":"Nick Fisher"}],"priority":1}]}]}
